title: Pilih dunia visual Jejak
question: Re-roll: the roll assigned Sogan. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Sogan
options.lineage: classic Solo and Yogya sogan batik tulis
options.thesis: Like wax-resist cloth, a verified day takes the dye: matched days fill with fine cecek dots, gaps stay as open outline.
options.viewport: Cocokkan: indigo header with step tabs, the month as a 7-column grid of day cells; matched cells filled soga brown with a cecek dot texture, mismatch cells left as a red outline, the open day's detail below.
options.risk: Batik on a working screen can read as heritage tourism if it reaches past palette and the dot fill.

raised.raise: A flagged day stays lit until the owner has confirmed or explained it.
Day size is constant; only fill and outline carry status, never decoration.
Every month renders at the same scale on the same grid, so months compare directly.
One number leads each screen; everything else steps back.
The action plan shows only the next decision, its date at full scale.

options.label: Kalender Dinding
options.lineage: free wall calendars from toko emas and bank branches
options.thesis: The month as the wall calendar every warung hangs: big numerals, red Sundays, each day marked as checked.
options.viewport: Cocokkan as a full calendar sheet: huge date numerals, a green tick ring on matched days, red circled days with the gap amount, pasaran-style small line under each date for the bank amount.
options.risk: Familiar and calendar-shaped, close to what most runs would ship for a day-by-day screen.

options.label: Tiket & Papan Jadwal
options.thesis: Each day a ticket stub: Excel and bank as its two torn halves; a changed row stays lit until noticed.
options.viewport: Cocokkan as a departure board of days, tabular columns Tanggal / Excel / Bank / Status, the flagged rows lit orange and held.
options.case: Holds product clarity: the board is a natural reconciliation table. Loses on audience: travel ephemera, not warung life.
options.risk: Can read as a travel app.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Hierarchy by dot size on a fixed ramp.
options.case: No owner sees their sales as stars.
options.kept: Status carried by fill and outline only.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Same scale, same ground, every stage.
options.kept: Every month at the same scale.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: One number as the only headline.

options.label: Terminal Yellow
options.case: Strong for a plan, foreign to the audience.
options.kept: Plan shows only the next step.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white fintech card app with a green accent, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A summary card, then a list of day cards with status chips.
canonCard.risk: Reads like a bank or pinjol app, which you asked to avoid.
